mapper.insert: insert into setmeal (name, category_id, price, image, description, status) values (#{name}, #{categoryId}, #{price}, #{image}, #{description}, #{status})
insert into setmeal_dish (setmeal_id, dish_id, name, image, description, price)
mapper.select:
-- -- 这个c.name as categoryName的意思是给c表的name字段取别名为categoryName -- 虽然这个别名没有用到,但如果不设置别名的话,结果集会有两个name -- 一个是setmeal表,一个是c表的name,导致结果集的两个name会冲突覆盖,不能够正常映射 -- 所以要取一个能够和VO属性映射的别名 select s.*,c.name as categoryName from setmeal as s left outer join category as c on s.category_id=c.id
and s.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and s.category_id like concat('%',#{categoryId},'%')
and s.status =#{status}
order by s.update_time desc
